summary: fractal-ui transcripts render host-supplied thread images inline (prompt attachments, work-row screenshots folded with thumbnails, reply images) with explicit loading, failed, gone, too-large and unsupported states, and open them in a keyboard-accessible viewer that steps through every image in the thread with caption, counter, filmstrip and zoom

replay.detail: Client-only change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Additive optional kit props; existing transcripts render unchanged without images.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; the app does not supply images yet.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
